Card Q&A.a: Yes. Even if the Digimon is blocked, if you declared an attack against your opponent, the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: I attack my opponent using a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this Digimon's effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, it gets +1000 DP for the turn.
Notes: DIGIMON CARD GAME FEST Digi-Egg Set
